verdict: P105-GATE-CALIBRATION (specificity of the earned gate on labelled REAL candidates, offline): on the union of 12 distinct committed hosts whose ground truth is "catalogued planet" (a discovery-tier output would be a false claim), the gate returned tier none for 12/12 -> 0 false promotion(s), specificity 1.000, Wilson 95% lower bound on the true-negative rate 0.757. Binding refusals (over the 9 hosts carrying unmet lists): novelty 9/9, prospective precision 0/9, blend 9/9, PSF 9/9. This validates the REFUSALS: the gate does not over-claim on any real labelled planet we hold. The SENSITIVITY arm (promoting a clean NOVEL signal) is only established synthetically (p100) because committed data has no labelled novel candidate to test it on -- an asymmetry stated, not hidden. No claim, no gate.
